environment.description: CI/CD pipeline OAuth plugin deployed on EC2 behind CloudFront distribution (ID: E2XYZABC123) with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy attached. The origin is an ALB with a custom header validation (X-Origin-Verify: <rotating-secret>) that rejects requests without the header. CloudFront behaviors are configured with a custom cache policy (CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad) that forwards query strings but requires CloudFront Signed URLs (Trusted Key Group: kg-pipeline-auth-2024) for ALL paths matching /auth/*. The key group uses an RSA-2048 key pair where the private key is stored in AWS Secrets Manager (arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789:secret/cf-signing-key). Requests to /auth/login and /auth/callback without valid CloudFront signed URL parameters (Policy, Signature, Key-Pair-Id) receive a 403 from CloudFront edge before reaching origin. The signed URL policy restricts the resource URL pattern to https://plugin.ci.internal.corp/auth/* and includes an IP condition limiting source IPs to the internal VPN CIDR 10.0.0.0/8. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution has a response headers policy that strips any token= query parameter from redirect responses via a CloudFront Function (cf-strip-token-from-redirects) attached to the viewer-response event.

origin_access_control.alb_rule: reject if X-Origin-Verify header missing or invalid

cloudfront_function.name: cf-strip-token-from-redirects
cloudfront_function.behavior: removes token= parameter from Location header in 3xx responses
